methodology.method: Same-model authored text-only role simulations and same-model self-judgment
methodology.targetInstructions: Use only runtime promptText(reviewPrompt, variant, source) as target instructions. The corresponding source variant is not supplemented with full-version rules. Scenario setup and source turns are authored data, not observed user sessions.
methodology.inputProtocol: turns contains authored conversation context, a review request and the simulated assistant response. Templates represent instructions copied as USER-level messages, not system instructions, and grant no system authority. No execution occurred. Target template text is identified by its runtime hash rather than duplicated in turns. The isolation scenario substitutes its transcript field only as specified by inputConstruction; other cases use the unmodified runtime target.
methodology.hashMethod: SHA256 of UTF-8 runtime promptText output before any transcript-placeholder substitution, with no normalization.
methodology.limitations: One illustrative authored response per case, self-judged by its author. No model/provider execution, independent model calls, audio synthesis, voice parity, measured timing, statistical reliability, browser behavior, or UI integration established. English metadata and Chinese explanations with English learning examples. Pass applies only to the sampled behavior, not every requirement or adversarial variant. Uncertain IPA is explicitly unverified; familiar reference IPA is also not dictionary-verified.

sourceFindings.finding: Spoken review intentionally supports only current-chat source in the UI, where the source picker is hidden. Calling runtime promptText with spoken + transcript returns spokenPrompt without a transcript-source override; that combination is outside the supported UI flow, not a material feature failure.
sourceFindings.coverage: The two transcript-source cases test full templates only. Spoken + transcript use is unsupported by the UI and unverified by this fixture; do not infer isolation support from these pass judgments.

sourceFindings.finding: All four spoken reviews explicitly require usable conversation, available details, and maximum counts. Compact scripts still omit some full-version detail, including explicit partial-history coverage disclosure and comprehensive source-attribution safeguards. Sampled passes do not establish reliability on those omitted branches.

coverage.base: Four full current-chat and four spoken current-chat cases
coverage.extra: Full transcript-source isolation with real multiline speaker labels and embedded instructions; full missing-transcript placeholder; missing-context cases for all four spoken reviews.
coverage.oralFallback: Dedicated heldout-notes-voice-only case represents a brief complete-notes oral fallback without IPA or worksheets as authored text. Other spoken review samples request written output; no audio execution.

methodology.revisionProvenance: 5 replacement and 5 additional same-model authored text-only role simulations, one self-judged sample per case. 5 unchanged-target case transcripts and judgments retained; integrity digests added. methodology.evidenceIntegrity: Canonical case SHA-256 covers instructions hash, inputs, responses, and judgments; it is an integrity check, not independent semantic validation. Added digests do not count as fresh model samples.

turns.content: Yesterday I go to Kyoto. I loved the gardens.
Say “Yesterday I went to Kyoto.” You could also say “The gardens were peaceful.”
On a different topic, I cook at home to save money. What does budget mean here?
A budget is a spending plan. You can say “stick to a budget.”
I cook at home to save money. I have not tried saying your budget phrase yet.
Practice is finished. Make the study notes.

## Conversation recap
你谈了京都旅行和花园，也谈了在家做饭省钱，并询问 budget 的意思。这些是你的经历和看法，未作外部核实。
## Corrections
你的原话：“Yesterday I go to Kyoto.” → “Yesterday I went to Kyoto.” Yesterday 指过去，用 went。这是真实语法错误。
可选表达（不是纠错）：AI 说过 “The gardens were peaceful.”；你原来的 “I loved the gardens.” 已自然，保留原句。
## Useful sentences
你：“I loved the gardens.”；你：“I cook at home to save money.”；AI：“stick to a budget”。AI 的建议不代表你已用过或掌握。
## Vocabulary
budget，名词，语境中指开支计划；美式参考 /ˈbʌdʒɪt/，未经词典或音频核验。搭配：stick to a budget。聊天例句（AI）：“A budget is a spending plan.”
## Review practice
1. 把你那句昨天去京都的话改成过去时。
2. 表达你喜欢那些花园。
3. 表达在家做饭以省钱。
## Answers
1. Yesterday I went to Kyoto. / I went to Kyoto yesterday.
2. I loved the gardens.
3. I cook at home to save money. / I save money by cooking at home.
## Next priorities
练习 went 的过去时；试着亲自使用 stick to a budget。

scenarios.rationale: Covers both main topics rather than only the correction. Exact quotations and AI attribution are preserved. Distinguishes a real tense error from optional style, includes natural learner sentences, a contextual noun IPA reference without verification claims, separate recall answers and two grounded priorities. No mastery is inferred.

## Questions
共三张卡片，各练一个不同的学习点。第 1 题引用你的真实错句，第 2、3 题是根据聊天新写的自学题。
1. 纠正你说过的句子：“Yesterday I go to Kyoto.” 保留原意和时间。
2. 用英语表达：我在家做饭是为了省钱。
3. 填入聊天中表示“开支计划”的一个名词：A ___ is a plan for spending money.
## Answer key
1. Yesterday I went to Kyoto. / I went to Kyoto yesterday. 昨天的事情用过去时 went。
2. I cook at home to save money. / I save money by cooking at home. 两种说法都能表达做饭与省钱的关系；你的原句本来就自然，不是纠错。
3. budget。这里是名词，指开支计划。这是你问过的词，不据此判断你已掌握。
这些题用于之后自学，不开始新一轮问答。
